He distinguishes body from soul, calls the body a garment worn for fifty or a hundred years, and observes that people feed the body three meals a day while giving the real person nothing, describing the soul as literally a piece of the breath God breathed into Adam and claiming it can grow to immense size when nourished. He says the nourishment is a specific method rather than vague spirituality or ordinary supplication: five daily contacts with God following what he compares to the numerical combination of a safe, with fasting as a further practice, and he offers newly obtained mathematically coded evidence as his authority. Citing the Barbara Hutton story and Eddie Murphy's interview with Barbara Walters as cases of wealth without happiness, he closes by inviting viewers to examine the physical evidence free of charge, giving an address on East 6th Street in Tucson and a telephone number.
